profile.text: Yun Qingping, former record keeper of Yan, responsible for documenting martial arts for use by Yanese soldiers. Currently stationed at Rhodes Island as a representative of the Sui Regulator at Operator Zuo Le's recommendation. He participates in the observation and documentation of the Sui Proxies while also assisting Rhodes Island with its logistics work.
